noun_data.noun_definition: A card title is a label or name assigned to a specific card, used to identify its purpose or owner.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the card title is included in the parameters for creating a new Expensify card, indicating the specific name or label that will be associated with the card being issued.

noun_data.noun_definition: An expense report title is a designated name or label used to identify a specific expense report within a policy framework.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the title is used to manage the visibility and customization options for the expense report title within a policy, determining whether users can create custom titles and if those options are enabled or disabled based on the policy settings.

noun_data.noun_definition: An expense report title is a descriptive label that summarizes the financial obligation represented by the report.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the title is dynamically generated based on the policy name and the formatted total amount, and it may be further customized using a formula if specific conditions related to the report's policy are met.

noun_data.noun_definition: The export account title is a specific identifier used to represent an account designated for exporting financial data in various accounting systems.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the title is determined based on the type of non-reimbursable expenses export destination and is used to identify the specific account associated with the company card for exporting data to QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or Sage Intacct.

noun_data.noun_definition: The expense limit type title is a textual representation that describes a specific category of expense limits within a workspace's rules.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the title is dynamically generated using a translation function that retrieves the appropriate label for the selected expense limit type based on the default value, which is then displayed in the user interface.

noun_data.noun_definition: A category title is a label that represents a specific classification or group within a selection interface.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the title is used to display the currently selected category in the user interface, and it is updated when a new category is selected from the picker modal.

noun_data.noun_definition: The unit selection title is a formatted string that represents the currently selected unit in a user interface component.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the title is derived from the defaultValue prop, which is translated and capitalized to provide a user-friendly display of the currently selected unit, enhancing the user experience in the unit selection process.

noun_data.noun_definition: The tax rate title is a label that represents the name of a specific tax applicable to a financial transaction.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the tax rate title is derived from the current transaction and policy, and it is used to display the selected tax rate in the user interface, allowing users to understand which tax is being applied to their transaction.

noun_data.noun_definition: A receipt title is a label or heading that identifies the purpose or type of a receipt.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the receipt title is used to provide context for the uploaded receipt, ensuring that users can identify the receipt's purpose, which is crucial for processing financial transactions accurately.

noun_data.noun_definition: The initial settings page title is a label that identifies the main settings interface for user configuration.
noun_data.noun_summary: The title is relevant in the context of the InitialSettingsPage function as it serves as a reference point for the user interface, indicating the purpose of the page where users can manage their account settings and preferences.

noun_data.noun_definition: The subscription settings title is a label that represents the section of the user interface where subscription-related configurations are displayed.
noun_data.noun_summary: The title is used in the Section component to label the area where users can manage their subscription settings, providing context for the options available to them.

noun_data.noun_definition: A quick action title is a label that describes a specific action that can be performed quickly within the application.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the quick action title is dynamically generated based on the current quick action and its associated report, providing users with a clear and contextual label for the action they are about to take.

noun_data.noun_definition: A link preview title is the textual representation of a hyperlink that provides a brief indication of the content or subject matter of the linked resource.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the title is conditionally rendered as part of the link preview if it exists alongside the URL, serving as a clickable element that directs users to the associated link.

noun_data.noun_definition: A search type menu item title is a label that represents a specific category of search results within a user interface.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the title is used as a label for various search type menu items, such as expenses, chats, invoices, and trips, which are displayed to the user to facilitate navigation and selection of different search categories.

noun_data.noun_definition: A search filter title is a label or name used to identify a specific filter applied to search results.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the title is used to determine if a specific search filter is currently active, influencing the display of menu items and the selection state within the search type menu.

noun_data.noun_definition: A filter title is a label that describes a specific search filter used in an advanced search interface.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the filter title is dynamically generated based on the current search filters and their configurations, providing users with contextual information about each filter option available for selection.

noun_data.noun_definition: The business type title is a label that represents the specific category or classification of a business entity.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the title is derived from the current value of the business type, translating it into a user-friendly format for display, which helps users understand the selected business type in the context of their incorporation.

noun_data.noun_definition: The title is a designated name or heading that summarizes the content or purpose of a policy report.

noun_data.noun_definition: A report title field is a designated area within a report that contains its title or heading.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the logic checks if the report title field is disabled based on whether the report is settled or closed, and whether the user has administrative privileges over the policy associated with the report.

noun_data.noun_definition: A money request report title is a designated name that identifies a specific financial request report within a system.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the title is derived from the report's name if it is a settled report and belongs to a paid group policy expense report; otherwise, it is constructed based on the payer's name and the total amount spent, reflecting the status of the report and its associated transactions.

noun_data.noun_definition: The search header title is a formatted string that summarizes the search criteria and filters applied in a search query.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the title is constructed by combining the type and status from the search query, along with any applied filters, including tax rates and other criteria, to provide a clear representation of the current search context.

noun_data.noun_definition: The ownership change notification title is a label that indicates the subject of a message regarding the transfer of ownership in a policy context.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the title is dynamically assigned based on specific ownership error scenarios, providing users with relevant information about the nature of the ownership issue they are facing.

noun_data.noun_definition: A custom report title is a user-defined label that can be assigned to a report generated from a policy.
noun_data.noun_summary: The function enables or disables the option for a policy to show a custom report title, updating the policy's state and handling optimistic updates, success, and failure scenarios based on the user's action.

noun_data.noun_definition: The default report title is the primary name assigned to a report generated from a policy.
noun_data.noun_summary: The function sets the default report title for a specific policy, updating it only if the new custom name differs from the current default value, while managing optimistic updates and handling potential errors during the API call.

noun_data.noun_definition: A policy report title is a designated name or heading that summarizes the content or purpose of a specific policy document.
noun_data.noun_summary: The function modifies the deletable status of the policy report title based on whether the policy is enforced or not, ensuring that the title can be updated accordingly while managing optimistic updates and error handling.

noun_data.noun_definition: A title is a name given to a book, article, or other work that indicates its subject or theme.
